name: Video Downloader From Anywhere™
_comment_host_permissions: host_permissions <all_urls> is required because this extension's single purpose is detecting and downloading videos from any website the user chooses to visit. The extension cannot know in advance which sites the user will browse. It uses webRequest to intercept video MIME-type responses, and a content script to scan DOM video elements — both of which require matching the active page URL. Restricting to a fixed list of domains would make the extension non-functional for its declared purpose.
